note: The corridors scripts/test_corridor_severance.mjs asserts for this state. Moved here verbatim from that test file, which held them as a PAIRS constant: a corridor is a state fact and belongs beside the state's data, not in shared test code. 'maxRatio' is a severance detector, not a distance pin (lesson G2).

corridors.name: DuPont -> Nisqually (the severed link)
corridors.why: Brackets the 89 m emergency-access way (OSM w12189384) whose absence left 1.3 mi of I-5 as the only way out of DuPont and turned Tacoma-Olympia into a 54 mi ride against a 26 mi straight line.

corridors.name: Tacoma -> Olympia
corridors.why: The corridor the severance showed up on, at 10.7x the straight line.

corridors.name: Seattle -> Everett
